This neuron is essentially an end-of-paragraph detector with inverted sign: it is strongly suppressed (most-negative) by sentence-final punctuation immediately followed by a newline (".\n", "?\n"), while its weak positive firing occurs on word-completing subword fragments/tokens in mid-sentence continuations (e.g. "-ino", "-istry", "-w" in "thwacked", " internet", " consideration").

This neuron fires positively at segment/sentence boundaries where fresh, unpredictable content starts (the ".\n" newline break, the first token of a new sentence or list entry, e.g. "There are **a** number of…", "meeting **of** our…"), and is strongly suppressed on tokens that merely echo an earlier word in a parallel/repeated construction ("Agency, Company **or** Company", "re-enable … **re-enable**", "gains **and** harms", "Map… **Map**").
